name: Avoid Routines having a very low Comment/Code ratio (Rexx)
description:
This quality rule reports all Routines with a ratio comment/code <= X % (by default X=5)
The threshold is a parameter and can be changed at will.
output:
This report lists all Rexx Routines with comment/code ratio lower than X %
It provides the following information:
 Routine full name, comment/code ratio
rationale: Maintainability of the code is facilitated if there is documentation in the code. This rule will ensure there are comments within the Routines.
alternativeName: Enrich your code with comments to give an overview of the code to improve maintainability

parameters.name: Minimum % Comment / Code Ratio
parameters.description: Minimum % Comment / Code Ratio for Routines
